name: UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE)
frequency: Once a Year (Notification in Feb, Prelims in May/June)
overview: UPSC CSE is the premier examination in India to select administrative leadership for governing districts, enforcing national law, directing foreign diplomacy, and formulating national policy.
overview_hi: यूपीएससी सिविल सेवा परीक्षा भारत की सबसे प्रतिष्ठित प्रतियोगी परीक्षा है, जिसके माध्यम से आईएएस, आईपीएस, आईएफएस और आईआरएस अधिकारियों का चयन होता है।

eligibility.qualification: Graduation in any stream (BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, MBBS etc.) from a recognized university. Final year students can apply.

relaxations.age_limit: Standard category age applies + ₹0 (Nil) Application Fee

papers: GS Paper 1: 100 MCQs, 200 marks, 2 hours (Merit cutoff determination)
CSAT Paper 2: 80 MCQs, 200 marks, 2 hours (Qualifying: need 33% / 66 marks)
Paper A & B: Indian Language & English (300 marks each, Qualifying 25%)
Paper 2, 3, 4, 5: General Studies I, II, III, IV (250 marks each = 1,000 marks)
Paper 6 & 7: Optional Subject Paper 1 & 2 (250 marks each = 500 marks)

stages.details: 275 marks in Dholpur House, New Delhi before an eminent board

syllabus.prelims: Current events of national & international importance, History of India & Indian National Movement, Indian & World Geography, Indian Polity & Governance, Economic & Social Development, Environmental Ecology & Climate Change, General Science.
syllabus.mains_gs1: Indian Heritage, Culture, Modern History, Freedom Struggle, Post-Independence, World History, Society, Geography.
syllabus.mains_gs2: Constitution, Polity, Governance, Social Justice, Welfare Schemes, International Relations.
syllabus.mains_gs3: Economy, Agriculture, Science & Tech, Environment, Internal Security, Disaster Management.
syllabus.mains_gs4: Ethics, Integrity, Aptitude, Case Studies of administrative dilemmas.

roadmap_timeline.title: NCERT Foundations & Syllabus Blueprint
roadmap_timeline.description: Read NCERT Class 6-12 (History, Geography, Polity, Economy). Understand previous 10 years question trends. Choose optional subject.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: NCERT summaries completed; Daily newspaper reading established

roadmap_timeline.title: Standard Reference Textbooks
roadmap_timeline.description: M. Laxmikanth (Polity), Ramesh Singh/Nitin Singhania (Economy), Spectrum (Modern History), PMF IAS / Shankar (Environment). Start daily 1 answer writing.

roadmap_timeline.title: Optional Subject & Mains Answer Writing
roadmap_timeline.description: Complete Optional Papers 1 & 2. Write 50+ GS full-length answers and 10 essays. Integrate current affairs with static syllabus.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Optional syllabus covered twice with handwritten notes

roadmap_timeline.title: Prelims MCQ Drill & Mock Tests
roadmap_timeline.description: Solve 40-50 full mock tests for Prelims GS-1 and CSAT. Master elimination techniques and revision of facts/maps.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Consistent 100+ score in mock tests; CSAT fear eliminated

salary_and_perks.pay_scale: Level 10 of 7th CPC (Basic ₹56,100 + DA + HRA/Official Bungalow)
salary_and_perks.promotions: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) -> District Magistrate (DM/Collector) -> Divisional Commissioner -> Joint Secretary -> Secretary to Govt of India (₹2,25,000)
perks: Government Bungalow with security guard & staff
Official Vehicle with beacon/driver
100% Medical CGHS cover for whole family
Electricity, water, telephone quota
Study leave abroad fully paid

free_resources.title: Sansad TV & PIB Official Daily Press Briefings

faqs.q: Can rural or Hindi medium students clear UPSC CSE?
faqs.a: Yes! Every year dozens of top 100 rankers come from Hindi, Marathi, and Tamil mediums. UPSC evaluates analytical understanding, not fancy English vocabulary.

faqs.q: Is coaching mandatory to crack UPSC?
faqs.a: No. With standard NCERTs, PIB, and free online lectures on YouTube/Sansad TV, thousands of aspirants clear by disciplined self-study.

name: SSC Combined Graduate Level (SSC CGL)
target_roles: Assistant Section Officer (ASO) in MEA / CSS / Railway
overview: SSC CGL is India's most popular graduate exam recruiting Group B & C officers in Central Ministries, CBI, Intelligence Bureau, and Tax Directorates.
overview_hi: केंद्रीय मंत्रालयों, इनकम टैक्स और एक्साइज में इंस्पेक्टर तथा डेस्क ऑफिसर बनने के लिए सबसे लोकप्रिय ग्रेजुएट परीक्षा।

eligibility.qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University.
eligibility.attempts_general: No attempt limit (as long as within age criteria)

papers: Section 1: Math (30 Qs) + Reasoning (30 Qs) = 180 Marks (1 hr)
Section 2: English (45 Qs) + General Awareness (25 Qs) = 210 Marks (1 hr)
Section 3: Computer Knowledge (20 Qs, 60 Marks - Qualifying)
Section 4: Data Entry Speed Test (2,000 key depressions in 15 mins - Qualifying)

syllabus.math: Arithmetic (Percentages, Ratio, SI/CI, Time & Work), Advance Math (Algebra, Trigonometry, Geometry, Mensuration).
syllabus.reasoning: Analogies, Syllogism, Blood Relations, Coding-Decoding, Non-verbal series, Puzzles.
syllabus.english: Grammar rules, Cloze test, Active/Passive, Direct/Indirect speech, Reading comprehension, Idioms.
syllabus.gk: History, Polity, Geography, General Science, Static GK (Folk dances, national parks), Monthly Current Affairs.

roadmap_timeline.title: Aptitude Fundamentals & Speed Math
roadmap_timeline.description: Learn tables up to 30, squares up to 50, cubes up to 30. Clear basic concepts of Arithmetic and Grammar rules (Neetu Singh Vol 1).

roadmap_timeline.title: Advance Math & Reasoning Drill
roadmap_timeline.description: Master Trigonometry, Geometry, and Algebra. Practice 50 reasoning questions daily. Revise NCERT Science Class 9-10.

roadmap_timeline.title: Previous 5 Years Question Papers (PYQs) & Mocks
roadmap_timeline.description: Solve TCS PYQ sets (Kiran or Pinnacle). Take 3 full mock tests per week with deep question-level error analysis.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Consistently scoring 140+ in Tier-1 Mocks and 310+ in Tier-2

salary_and_perks.pay_scale: Pay Level 7 (Basic ₹44,900) or Level 4-6 depending on post
salary_and_perks.in_hand: ₹65,000 - ₹82,000 / month (in X Cities like Delhi, Mumbai) + HRA/Quarters
salary_and_perks.promotions: Inspector -> Superintendent -> Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax / GST
perks: Central Govt CGHS Medical Facility
Government Quarters in Central Govt Enclaves
LTC (Leave Travel Concession) all India every 2 years
Stable desk or field enforcement duties

free_resources.title: TCS Previous Year Question Solved Playlists

faqs.q: Is interview conducted in SSC CGL?
faqs.a: No! Interviews have been abolished for all SSC CGL Group B & C posts. Selection is 100% based on Tier-2 CBT computer test marks.

name: IBPS Probationary Officer (IBPS PO)
overview: IBPS recruits probationary officers across 11 nationalized public sector banks (PNB, Canara, Bank of Baroda, Union Bank, etc.) with fixed exam calendars.
overview_hi: 11 प्रमुख सरकारी बैंकों में प्रोबेशनरी ऑफिसर (PO) भर्ती। 6 महीने में चयन प्रक्रिया पूरी होने वाली सबसे तेज़ परीक्षा।

stages.duration: 60 mins (100 Qs, 100 Marks) with sectional timing

papers: General / Economy / Banking Awareness (40 Qs, 40 Marks)

stages.details: 100 marks panel interview in respective regional zonal office

syllabus.prelims: Number series, Simplification, Quadratic equations, Data Interpretation, Syllogisms, Seating arrangement, Puzzles, Reading comprehension, Para jumbles.
syllabus.mains: Advanced DI (Caselet, Radar, Missing DI), High-level circular & floor puzzles, RBI Monetary policy, Priority Sector Lending (PSL), Union Budget, Financial news.

roadmap_timeline.title: Speed Techniques & High-Speed Calculation
roadmap_timeline.description: Practice 50 Simplification, 20 Quadratic, 20 Number Series questions every single morning. Build speed on calculations.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Solving DI sets in under 4 minutes

roadmap_timeline.title: Complex Puzzles & Mains DI Drill
roadmap_timeline.description: Practice 5 uncertain puzzles daily. Learn Caselet DI and Probability. Read Indian Express / The Hindu Business page.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Clearing sectional cutoffs in Mains practice mocks

roadmap_timeline.title: Banking Awareness Capsule & Mock Test Marathon
roadmap_timeline.description: Memorize RBI circulars, banking terms, current affairs of past 6 months. Take 20 Prelims + 10 Mains full-length mocks.

salary_and_perks.pay_scale: Basic ₹36,000 + DA + Special Allowance + HRA (Revised under 12th BPS to ₹48,480 Basic)
salary_and_perks.promotions: Scale 1 (PO) -> Scale 2 (Manager) -> Scale 3 (Senior Manager) -> Scale 4 (Chief Manager) -> AGM -> DGM -> General Manager
perks: Leased accommodation up to ₹25,000/mo depending on city
Subsidized staff home loan at ~4-5% interest
Newspaper, petrol allowance (50-60 litres/mo), medical reimbursement

free_resources.title: RBI FAQs on Monetary Policy & Banking Terms

faqs.a: IBPS is known for the most punctual recruitment in India. From Prelims in October to joining letter in April, it strictly takes only 6 months.

name: State Bank of India Probationary Officer (SBI PO)
organizer: State Bank of India Central Recruitment Board
overview: SBI PO is the pinnacle of Indian banking careers. Offers the highest compensation package in public banking with international branch postings.
overview_hi: भारत के सबसे बड़े सरकारी बैंक (SBI) में ऑफिसर बनने की प्रतिष्ठित परीक्षा। बेहतरीन वेतन और विदेश में पोस्टिंग के मौके।

stages.stage: Phase 3: Psychometric Test + Group Discussion (20 Marks) + Personal Interview (30 Marks)

syllabus.prelims: Speed Math, Arithmetic, Logical Puzzles, Coding-Decoding, Reading comprehension, Vocabulary in context.
syllabus.mains: Tough DI (Probability DI, Funnel DI), Critical Reasoning (Assumption, Inference), Financial GK, IT in Banking.

roadmap_timeline.title: Speed Foundation & High Level Concepts
roadmap_timeline.description: Master all Arithmetic topics. Practice critical reasoning logic. Improve descriptive typing speed on computer.

roadmap_timeline.title: Tough Mock Tests & GD Practice
roadmap_timeline.description: Solve toughest SBI PO previous papers. Practice speaking on current economic issues for Group Discussion round.

salary_and_perks.pay_scale: 4 advance increments given to SBI POs directly at joining
salary_and_perks.in_hand: ₹75,000 - ₹85,000 / month + Leased accommodation (up to ₹30,000 in Mumbai)
salary_and_perks.promotions: Rapid promotion track: Scale I to Scale IV achievable in 9 years
perks: Foreign posting opportunities in London, New York, Singapore branches
Concessional loans for car, house, personal needs
Highest medical cover 100% cashless

faqs.q: What is the difference between SBI PO and IBPS PO?
faqs.a: SBI PO gives 4 advance increments resulting in ~₹10,000-15,000 higher monthly compensation than regular IBPS POs.

name: Railway Non-Technical Popular Categories (RRB NTPC)
overview: Massive Indian Railways recruitment for operational and administrative posts with lifetime railway family travel passes across India.
overview_hi: भारतीय रेलवे में स्टेशन मास्टर, गुड्स गार्ड (ट्रेन मैनेजर) और लिपिक बनने का सबसे बड़ा अवसर। पूरे भारत में फ्री रेल पास।

eligibility.qualification: 12th Pass for Undergraduate posts (Level 2 & 3); Graduate for Level 4, 5, 6 posts (Station Master, Goods Guard).

stages.details: Computer Based Aptitude Test (Psychology test) for Station Master; Typing Test for Clerks

syllabus.math: Number System, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio, Percentages, Mensuration, Time and Work, Simple Interest, Geometry, Elementary Statistics.
syllabus.reasoning: Analogies, Completion of Number and Alphabetical Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Similarities, Syllogism, Venn Diagrams.
syllabus.ga: Current Events, Games and Sports, Art and Culture of India, Indian Literature, Monuments and Places of India, General Science (up to 10th CBSE), Indian Polity.

roadmap_timeline.title: NCERT Science & Railway GK Mastery
roadmap_timeline.description: Master Class 9 & 10 Physics, Chemistry, Biology concepts (heavily asked by RRB). Practice speed math arithmetic.

roadmap_timeline.title: CBT-2 Level Problem Solving & Mock Tests
roadmap_timeline.description: Practice 120-question sets in 90 minutes. Focus on high accuracy (negative marking is 1/3rd).

salary_and_perks.in_hand: ₹32,000 (Clerk) to ₹65,000+ (Station Master / Goods Guard with running allowances)
salary_and_perks.promotions: Station Master -> Station Superintendent -> Assistant Operating Manager (AOM)
perks: Free 1st Class Railway Family Passes for pan-India travel
Railway Quarters and dedicated Railway Hospitals
Subsidized holiday homes across all tourist locations in India

faqs.q: Do Goods Guards and Station Masters get extra allowances?
faqs.a: Yes! Running allowances, night duty allowances, and national holiday allowances add ₹15,000 - ₹25,000 extra on top of basic salary.

name: NDA & CDS Defence Officers (Army / Navy / Air Force)
frequency: Twice a Year (NDA I & II, CDS I & II)
overview: Prestigious gateway to commissioning as a gazetted military officer directly after 12th (NDA) or after graduation (CDS). Completely free 4-year degree with stipend.
overview_hi: 12वीं के बाद (NDA) या ग्रेजुएशन के बाद (CDS) सेना में क्लास-1 ऑफिसर (लेफ्टिनेंट) बनने का सबसे गौरवशाली मार्ग।

eligibility.qualification: 12th Pass for NDA (PCM mandatory for Navy & Air Force; Any stream for Army). Graduation for CDS.

relaxations.age_limit: Now 100% eligible for NDA & CDS with equal permanent commission opportunities

papers: General Ability Test - English 200 + GK 400 (600 Marks, 2.5 hrs)
Day 2: Psychology Tests (TAT, WAT, SRT, SD)

syllabus.math: 11th & 12th Mathematics: Trigonometry, Matrices, Determinants, Calculus, Coordinate Geometry, Vectors, Statistics & Probability.
syllabus.gat: English Grammar, Comprehension, Indian Freedom Struggle, Geography, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Current Defence exercises.

roadmap_timeline.title: 11th-12th Math Formulas & English Grammar
roadmap_timeline.description: Solve RD Sharma Objective / Pathfinder for NDA. Read English newspapers daily to build vocabulary for GAT.

roadmap_timeline.title: Physical Fitness & SSB Personality Grooming
roadmap_timeline.description: Daily 2.4 km running, 20 pushups, 10 pullups. Practice Stage-1 PPDT story writing and lecturette topics.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: High physical stamina and OLQ (Officer Like Qualities) confidence

salary_and_perks.promotions: Lieutenant -> Captain (2 yrs) -> Major (6 yrs) -> Lt Colonel (13 yrs) -> Colonel -> Brigadier -> Major General
perks: Army Officers Mess & Club membership
Canteen Stores Department (CSD) tax-free amenities
Military Hospital 100% free treatment for officer and parents
Immense national respect and honor

faqs.a: Yes! Following the Supreme Court ruling, female candidates are fully eligible for NDA and train alongside male cadets at Khadakwasla.

name: CTET & State Teacher Eligibility Tests (TET)
organizer: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) / State Exam Boards
overview: Mandatory qualifying credential for securing government teaching appointments in Central Govt Schools (Kendriya Vidyalaya, Navodaya) and State Govt Schools.
overview_hi: केंद्रीय विद्यालय (KVS), नवोदय (NVS) और राज्य सरकारी स्कूलों में सरकारी शिक्षक बनने के लिए अनिवार्य पात्रता परीक्षा।

eligibility.qualification: Paper 1 (PRT): 12th + D.El.Ed (or B.El.Ed); Paper 2 (TGT): Graduation + B.Ed or 4-yr integrated teacher course.
eligibility.max_age_general: No upper age limit for CTET eligibility certificate!
eligibility.attempts_general: Unlimited attempts. Certificate is valid for LIFETIME.

stages.duration: 150 Qs, 150 Marks, 2.5 hrs. No negative marking!

papers: Maths & Science OR Social Studies (60 Qs)
stages.duration: 150 Qs, 150 Marks, 2.5 hrs. No negative marking!

syllabus.pedagogy: Theories of Piaget, Kohlberg, Vygotsky, Inclusive Education, Constructivist learning principles, Diagnostic & Remedial teaching.
syllabus.evs_science: NCERT Class 3 to 8 textbooks content on Family, Food, Shelter, Water, Travel, Things we make and do.

roadmap_timeline.title: Child Development & Learning Theories
roadmap_timeline.description: Master Piaget, Vygotsky and Kohlberg theories with NCERT B.Ed books.

roadmap_timeline.title: NCERT 3rd to 8th Subject Revision & PYQ Mocks
roadmap_timeline.description: Read all NCERT EVS and Social Science books. Solve last 10 CTET papers.

salary_and_perks.pay_scale: PRT: Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 Basic); TGT: Level 7 (₹44,900 Basic)
salary_and_perks.promotions: PRT -> TGT -> PGT (Lecturer) -> Vice Principal -> Principal
perks: 60-70 days summer & winter vacations paid
Safe 8 AM - 2 PM timing allowing family care
Free school education for own children in Kendriya Vidyalaya

free_resources.title: CTET Official Portal (Question Papers & Answer Keys)
DIKSHA Portal Free NCERT Teacher Modules

faqs.q: What is the validity of CTET certificate?
faqs.a: CBSE has made CTET certificate valid for LIFETIME. Once qualified, you can apply for KVS/DSSSB recruitment anytime.

name: State Public Service Commissions (UPPSC / BPSC / MPPSC / RAS)
overview: Premier state government administrative recruitment exam selecting top executive officers for district and block level administration within the home state.
overview_hi: अपने गृह राज्य में एसडीएम (SDM), डीएसपी (DSP), बीडीओ (BDO) बनने की सर्वोच्च राज्य प्रशासनिक परीक्षा।

relaxations.age_limit: Up to 45 years in states like UP, Rajasthan, Bihar

papers: General Studies Papers 1 to 6 (including 2 dedicated State Special Papers)

stages.details: 100 Marks personality evaluation before State Board

syllabus.state_special: State History, Geography, Culture, Folk Art, Tribal heritage, State Budget, State Welfare schemes, Mineral resources, Industrial corridors.
syllabus.general: Indian Constitution, Modern History, Macroeconomics, Ethics & Administration.

roadmap_timeline.title: State History, Culture & Geography Specialization
roadmap_timeline.description: Read comprehensive State Special GK books (e.g. Drishti UP Special, Crown Bihar GK). Learn local dialects and state economy.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Full notes on state geography and heritage ready

roadmap_timeline.title: GS 1-4 and State Mains Answer Writing
roadmap_timeline.description: Write answers with state-specific examples and data points. Focus on Hindi grammar for 100+ marks in Hindi paper.

salary_and_perks.in_hand: ₹68,000 - ₹88,000 / month + Official vehicle with driver & government bungalow
salary_and_perks.promotions: SDM -> Additional District Magistrate (ADM) -> Promoted to IAS cadre in 12-16 years!
perks: Highest local authority in the tehsil/district
Security guard and official residence
Power to pass administrative orders and supervise local police

faqs.q: Can a State PSC officer be promoted to IAS?
faqs.a: Yes! Around 33% of all IAS cadre posts in every state are reserved for promotion of State Civil Service (SDM) officers.

name: State Police Sub-Inspector & Constable Exam
organizer: State Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
overview: Most sought-after state uniform recruitment with huge vacancies (10,000 to 60,000 posts per cycle) ensuring fast local government employment.
overview_hi: राज्य पुलिस में दारोगा (SI) और सिपाही पद। हज़ारों पदों की भर्ती, वर्दी का सम्मान और स्थानीय इलाके में तैनाती।

eligibility.qualification: 12th Pass for Constable; Graduation for Sub-Inspector (SI).

relaxations.category: OBC / SC / ST of home state

relaxations.age_limit: Male Height: 168 cm, Chest 79-84 cm; Female Height: 152 cm; 4.8 km run in 25 mins

stages.stage: Stage 2: Physical Standard Test (PST) & Document Verification

stages.details: Male: 4.8 km running in 28 mins; Female: 2.4 km running in 16 mins

syllabus.law_constitution: Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, Traffic Rules, Women & Child Protection Acts, Cyber Crime basics, Human Rights.
syllabus.hindi: Hindi grammar, Sandhi, Samas, Ras, Chhand, Alankar, Muhavare, Famous Hindi poets and awards.
syllabus.math_reasoning: Number system, Percentages, Ratio, Distance, Series, Coding, Logical deductions.

roadmap_timeline.title: Physical Fitness Training & Hindi Grammar
roadmap_timeline.description: Start morning running routine (3-5 km). Master Hindi grammar (100 marks out of 400). Learn key articles of the Constitution.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Able to run 5 km without exhaustion; Hindi score 80%+

roadmap_timeline.title: Full Mocks & Speed Accuracy Drill
roadmap_timeline.description: Solve 30 full-length practice sets with timer. Focus on accuracy to avoid negative marks.
roadmap_timeline.milestone: Scoring 300+ out of 400 in mock tests

salary_and_perks.pay_scale: Constable: Level 3 (₹21,700 Basic); SI: Level 6 (₹35,400 Basic)
salary_and_perks.promotions: Constable -> Head Constable -> Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) -> Sub-Inspector (SI) -> Inspector
perks: Uniform allowance, ration money allowance (₹3,000/mo extra)
Police family welfare health facilities
Direct jurisdiction in Thana and investigative authority

faqs.q: What happens if someone fails the running test?
faqs.a: Running test is strictly qualifying. Even if you score top marks in written exam, failure to complete running within time leads to immediate disqualification.
